steps.text: I am signed in
I choose Category Management > Category
the table lists 10 rows starting "1 Over-charging fares · Over-charging of fares · Police"
the info line reads "Showing 1 to 10 of 10 entries" and the Category link is highlighted
the Add Category modal is open
I enter name "Tailgating", description "Following too closely", Owner "No owner" and press Save
the modal closes, row 11 "Tailgating" appears last, the info line reads "Showing 1 to 11 of 11 entries"
a toast reads Category "Tailgating" added successfully.
the Add Category modal is open and both fields are blank
I press Save
"Category name is required." and "Description is required." appear, both fields get a red ring, focus is on Category name, and no row is added
I press ✎ on row 1
the modal opens
the title is "Edit Category", name reads "Over-charging fares" and Owner reads "Police"
changing Owner to "No owner" and pressing Save blanks the Owner cell of row 1 and shows Category "Over-charging fares" updated successfully.
I press 🗑 on row 2 "Over Crowding"
the confirm reads Delete category "Over Crowding"? and I choose Cancel
10 rows remain
choosing OK instead removes the row, renumbers S No and shows "of 9 entries"
the list shows 10 rows
I type "police" in the search box
only row 1 is visible
a category modal is open with typed text
I press Esc
the modal closes and nothing is saved
